text: A friend dropped $1800 on each of three sealed packs of old magic cards hoping to flip them. He pulled a $4000 card, a $1000 card, and 30 others averaging $50. He swears he came out ahead, can you work out his actual profit?
kid asked me at practice which force pulls a soccer ball back down after he boots it into the air.
want a $30 jacket and two $20 shoe pairs. got $10, sat 4 times for $5, $4 a mow. how many mows?
pruning a tree, which two xylem cell types support it and move water and minerals?

I picked up ten packets of crayons for a kids art session. Six of the packets hold eight colors and the other four hold sixteen each. Trying to work out how many colors I ended up with altogether, can you do the sum with me?
Fog is rolling in over the bay and it moves about 3 miles every 10 minutes. Town runs 42 miles deep from the waterfront to the inland edge, so how many minutes before the whole place is socked in?
Helping a mate tally his weekend shoe sale: 14 pairs friday, twice that saturday, half of saturday on sunday, minus six pairs returned. what's the final count?
old clipping dated May 25 2008, a Mars lander digging for ice rich soil, which mission?
Repotting a few plants that hate sitting wet, which soil content drains best for that kind?
garden book mentioned a cycle taking in both photosynthesis and respiration, which one is that?
We were down at the beach and the swell got me thinking about sound waves. What do ocean waves and sound waves actually have in common, and why does it hold for both?
A problem set has 23Na at 198.52 MHz on a 750 MHz spectrometer and wants the magnetogyric ratio out of it. I keep going in circles, can you show the route through?
grandad insists TV rots your brain, give me one real way it has actually helped people.
Trying to size up a friend's walking against mine. He does 20 miles a day and drops to 10 on the weekend days, so what does his week total, and how does that split out?
dinner argument about inbred dog breeds, why does diversity within a species matter?
A video mentioned a satellite of mass m in a circular orbit of radius R around a planet of mass M then moved straight on. What does the time for one revolution actually depend on there?
Twenty people are coming over for the game and I'm making sandwiches that feed 4 each, a pound of meat and a pound of cheese per sandwich. Meat is $7.00 a pound, cheese $3.00. what's that costing me?
A neighbour was grumbling about the pesticide limits that come out of the Endangered Species Protection Program and I had no answer for him. What's the most likely reason those laws get enforced?

sat in on a sustainability talk and the slide had three blanks: supply chains replaced by one thing, product something made more important, and a redesign of every firm activity producing a certain output. what fills them?
got a two speed mower, an hour for the whole lawn on turtle or 40 minutes on rabbit. Did half in each mode today and wondering how many minutes that should have come to.
relative had a head injury and the MRI shows an extradural bleed, between which layers?

One of the plants on the windowsill has gone patchy, discolored with big brown blotches over the leaves. What's most likely causing it? watering hasn't changed at all so I can't see what else it would be.
read a piece about a baby born with macrostomia and it skipped the embryology completely. Which structures fail to fuse for that, and when is that fusion supposed to happen?
lab partner ran an E. coli transformation, what effect does that have on them?
Our school has 82 teachers, 13 called in sick friday and 9 subs came in. how many were actually there that day?
reading up on company law and one sentence lost me, how does a corporation stand to its managers, staff, investors and customers, what succession, and what about assets?
daughter asked why it goes dark at night and I fumbled it, what's the cause?
Our cat is roughly 5 times quicker than the tortoise and the cat clocks about 15 feet a second. how far would the tortoise get in 40 seconds?
candy day tomorrow, 30 ounces of sugar per sucker batch and 70 per fudge. doing 8 and 1, how much?
sparring 5 rounds of 3 minutes at 25 punches a minute, how many is that?
Reading about cell growth for a plant thing I'm doing and the article skipped the basics. What do cells actually need to grow at a normal rate, and what goes wrong without it?
settling something about the commuter line, 172 people aboard, first stop 47 off and 13 on, then another 38 off at the next. how many are left, and can you show the count after each stop?
The kids left a big block of ice on the sidewalk and it's warm out today. What happens to it and what state does it end up in? I'd rather explain it to them properly than guess.
planning some night photography and I need to know roughly how long a full lunar cycle runs, and what marks the start and end of one so I can time it.
coal ash got into the river upstream, which treatment stage takes out arsenic?
behind on videos, 72 a month and I've done 18, then 21, then 15. how many more?
working through a magnetic resonance text and got tangled, electron and proton in a 1.0 T field at 300 K, what is the magnitude of pe over pH?
Doing 90 shrimp for dinner tonight. I peel about 6 a minute and the pan handles 30 in 10 minutes, so how long is this taking me start to finish, peeling and cooking counted separately?
watching a space documentary, what exactly defines a star's habitable zone?
off on a nature walk, what's one advantage of a hand lens over a microscope?
coworker does 120 pounds of chocolate in two hours and I do 3/4 of that an hour, our 12 hour total?
someone offered me $2 a meter for my 20 meter rope, and a new one the same length runs $1.5 a meter at the shop. If I sell and rebuy, what do I pocket? show the sale and the purchase separately.
been doing short sprint intervals lately and got interested in the energy side. Which pathway rebuilds ATP fastest during exercise, and why is it quicker than the other routes available?
Taking stock of a marble store: 20 bought off a friend and added to the 50 already there, then dad chipped in 2/5 as many as were bought. Each weighs 2kg, so what does the lot weigh?
4 gallons of lemonade for a pool party, a cup of juice each and 6 lemons a cup, plus an extra gallon twice as tart. lemons?
going over notes from a molecular bio lecture I only half followed, what is needed to make an RNA/DNA hybrid from a single stranded RNA template?

there are three wolves that set each other off near the cabin. One howls for 20 seconds, the next goes twice as long, and the third matches the other two put together. how many minutes of howling is that in total?
Putting a food web drawing together with my nephew, what is a producer's main job in an ecosystem?
read that mature red blood cells have no nucleus and it threw me. What ability does a cell lose without one, and what was the nucleus handling that nothing else covers?
helping with a biology poster, what is the name for a group of specialized cells all doing the same job?
I teach and I'm trying to make chalk last. A 5-inch stick, normally 20% used a day, recycled once under 2 inches. Today I went over and used 45%. Back at 20% a day, how many days do I have?
My dog had 8 puppies, 3 spotted, and my neighbour's dog had 12 with 4 spotted. I'm writing a little post for the local dog group. Across both litters, what percentage of them have spots?
Rain here three days straight now. What actually causes rainstorms to form?
The manual for my chainsaw keeps saying to oil the moving parts that rub. Why does that matter?
Reading about my dad's heart failure diagnosis. What three factors regulate stroke volume?
doing 16 muffins tonight. each takes 5 tbsp flour, 3 sugar, .25 salt. dry total?
Going through some spectra a labmate left behind, there's a peak at 115.5 MHz taken in a 20.0 T field. Which nuclide would that be? I'd like to see the working.
Bro's phone is 4x mine, mine 2x older than sis's, hers is 1 yr. How old is his?
Watched a space documentary last night and it just asserted the universe is expanding. What's the evidence?
kit says my brown-eyed boys are Bb and BB. same genotype or phenotype?

Filling out a lab writeup where I have to give the mechanical energy a force exerted, and I don't know which unit belongs there. Which one properly expresses that, and how is it different from power or heat units?
At the mall I grabbed two $8 tees on a buy one get one half off deal and shoes that were 40% off $40. What did I spend?
rode 12 mph for 4.5 hrs, friend did 10 for 2.5. total miles between us?
Kid had twice his sister's candy. She ate 5, has 3 left. How much has he got?
Setting up a sundial in my yard upstate and want to mark the peak. About what time of day is the Sun highest in New York State?
After hard intervals my legs burn and someone told me the lactate goes somewhere. Once it leaves the muscle and enters the circulation, what mainly happens to it?
Helping with a school project on trees and we got to xylem cells, thick walls, most of the trunk and branches. Which vertebrate body system does the same job those cells do?
There was an arm wrestling thing at our office party, 20 matches, and the winner took 80 percent of them. How many did he lose? Show the working so I can put it on the board.

Reading about proton therapy where the protons run at roughly 0.6c and I got curious about the energy cost. Starting from rest, how much work does it take on a particle of mass m to reach that, in terms of m and c?
I'm speccing a truck out: $30,000 base, king cab $7,500, leather a third of the king cab, running boards $500 under the seats, light package $1500. What does that come to?
growing peas. round's dominant. pure round crossed with wrinkled gives me what?
Writing an intro paragraph for a community garden grant and the form wants a definition of sustainability. What's the broad standard one?
Broke my wrist snowboarding and the report lists bones I don't know. Name the carpals?
Was looking at a slide of my own blood at an open day and someone mentioned one of the cell types has no nucleus. Which cells in blood are those, and why do they end up that way?
A guy at my gym broke his neck, damage at the sixth cervical vertebra. Can he still breathe?

We're tuning a storage layer where a read costs 25 msec seek, 8 msec latency, 1 msec per 1,000 bytes transferred, and OS overhead of 1 msec per 1,000 bytes plus 10 msec. If we go from 1,000 byte blocks to 4,000, what's the ratio of new time to old on a large file?

Started with 7 fish in the pond, 3 orange and 4 white, then bought 17 more mixed from the shop. Now there's twice as many orange as white. How many white ones did I buy? Trying to work it back out from the receipt.

Doing HR induction paperwork at a new job and one section covers what workers owe the employer under their contract and under employment law generally. What's the proper name for that set of obligations?
Ran over a can in the driveway and it's totally flat. What happened to its atoms?
Kid found a grasshopper shell in the yard. What other animals shed like that?
Party order: 3 dozen donuts at $68 a dozen, 2 dozen cupcakes at $80, 6 dozen cheesecakes at $55. What's my total?
cake run: 4 monday, triple that tuesday, 5x tuesday's wednesday. total?
We did a shell hunt in a parking lot of all places, 20 of us, 700 shells, three teams. Team one got 40%, team two got 60% of what remained. How many did my team end up with?
Got on at floor 3 and the lift went to 4 times that plus 6. What floor am I on?
Getting 80 flagstones dropped at the house, each 75 pounds, and the yard says their trucks max out at 2000 pounds. If it all has to come in one trip, how many trucks am I paying for?
Dad's starting dialysis. Which of our own systems normally does that job?
After a dental job the front two-thirds of my tongue is numb. Which nerve?
A landlord did something to us that felt wrong but our solicitor says it's allowed, which got me thinking. How would you describe the relationship between ethics and the law generally?
phone's on 60% and climbing a percent every 3 minutes. how many hours till it's full?
I go through 2 pads a week sketching and each pad has 30 sheets. Trying to budget the year, so how many sheets is that per month?
Baking 36 cookies today and 30 tomorrow, and the recipe says two cups of flour per dozen. How much flour do I need in total so I'm not running back to the shop mid-batch?
We did the vinegar and baking soda volcano at home and the cup went cold, which surprised everyone. What energy transformation is happening when a reaction like that turns cool instead of warm?
My daughter counts clouds at lunch and told me she saw 3 on Monday and double the day before each day up to Friday. Adding all five days up, how many did she count in total?
walking the dog i noticed the sugar maples are red and the black oaks brown. what's that called?
Cooked with my flatmate, 98 minutes total, my bit ran 18 longer. Mine?
My PC has a big heat sink on the chip that spreads the heat it makes out into the case. Which kind of energy is that thing actually keeping away from the computer?
Deal I made with my son: cookies equal half the carrot sticks he eats, plus two for cleaning his room. He's after five cookies, so how many carrot sticks does he get through?
My nephew asked me where everything came from and I blanked. Which theory says the universe began as a single mass, and how would you explain it to a nine year old?
Studying up before shadowing in a clinic, and the autonomic outflow keeps tripping me up. Which spinal nerves do the parasympathetic preganglionic axons leave the CNS with?
Kid asked at breakfast what plants make out of sunlight. What's the answer?
We want to swap one thing at home this year to cut our carbon footprint. Which invention actually lowers the warming that comes from burning fossil fuels?
i get my car washed 4 times a month at $15 a go and my girlfriend reckons it adds up to way more than i think. what does that cost me over a year? show the working so i can prove it.
On my shift at the zoo I counted 12 females, half as many males, 14 cubs. Total?
my kid asked at dinner why salt is fine to eat when sodium blows up in water and chlorine gas is poisonous. what happens to those properties once the two react into NaCl?
At the store with $10 from mowing lawns. Peaches and pears are 50c, apples 75c, kiwis a dollar, plums a quarter. I've got 3 peaches, 4 pears, 2 kiwis and 5 apples. How many plums can I add?
saving for a $400 phone, i've got $80 put aside and just got paid for 20 hours at $10 an hour plus 15 hours at $5 at my weekend job. how much am i still short?
Just started waiting tables, $10 an hour plus about $15 an hour in tips, 40 hours a week. There's a $10000 car I want and the dealer wants 20% down. How many weeks until I've saved that up?
went down a rabbit hole reading about star sizes and one thing threw me. if a star has twice the mass of our Sun, what's actually different about it? explain what the extra mass changes.
Reading a tube feeding guide for my dad's home care and hypertonic keeps coming up. What does that mean for a solution compared with a normal human cell?
checking my algebra homework. what's (4x - 5)(2x^2 - 4x + 2) in Z_8[x]?
My son asked which particle an atom can lose and barely lose any mass. No clue.
i'm clearing a weedy patch in the yard and reading up on invasive plants. which adaptation would leave a plant less likely to survive?
Helping my niece with a chemistry sheet and I've gone blank. Which number is the one that actually identifies an element?
running the numbers on my uncle's grain trade. he buys bags at $20, pays $2 a bag to haul them, sells at $30, and cleared $400 profit. how many bags was that?
41 out this morning here and the forecast says sunny and mild. What should I expect by 2pm? Working out what to wear.
threw a branch in the creek and my kids wanted to know why it doesn't sink. what's the real reason wood sits on top of water? explain it so a seven year old follows it.
Splitting the potluck salad costs. I got 3 cucumbers at $2, Jack got 5 tomatoes at $1, Chase got lettuce for $3. What did we spend between us?
i'm writing a little simulation of a stick that snaps at two random spots along its length of 10. before i code it, what's the actual probability the three pieces make a triangle?
My class finished a soil study and next year's group will read it. What should they do so it's actually understandable?
sorting my thread stash, 15 light blue, 45 dark blue, 40 light green, 50 dark green. percent blue?
Ethics reading has me muddled. What's the code all rational beings should follow called, versus one group's own code?
8 overdue library books at 50 cents each plus a $2 flat fee. what do i owe?
The online gig I do pays $5 per 10 minutes. Today I worked 8 to 11 in the morning and took half an hour off in between. What did I earn for that stretch?
kid asked how sound gets to your ears. what's it doing to the air particles?
Timed my cat getting through nine sausages, took her 30 minutes, and the dog does the same nine in two thirds of that. What's the average time across the two of them?
Tallying the door count at the restaurant. 50 in the morning, 40 at ten, then double the ten o'clock number, then triple the first group. Total?
menu has juice A at $4, B is $5 over A, C is $7 over A. how much more is C than B?
Made a solar system mobile with my daughter and she asked what keeps the planets going round instead of drifting off. Which force does that, and how does it hold an orbit? Keep it simple.
my kid wants to know why everything circles the Sun and not some other object. what do i tell her?
We drip acid on mineral samples in my class to see if they bubble. What should the kids do with a sample afterwards?
setting up a phone tree for our neighbourhood group. i call 3 households, each of them calls 3 more, and so on down the line. how many get called on the fourth round? need to know before i promise.
Doing inventory for my classroom. 30 kids started with 10 pencils each, a fifth were gone after two months, and only a third of the rest lasted the year. How many do I have left?
my son is painting the planets in order on his bedroom wall and we're up to the fourth one from the Sun. which is it? tell me what colour to mix so we don't get it wrong either.
Working through group theory practice and hit the integers under a*b = a + b + 1. What's the identity element? Show how you'd get there.
my data has a nuclide, moment 2.884 x 10^-27 J T-1, spin 1. which one is it?
Putting together a poster on the rocky planets for a library display. Which ones have active plate tectonics, and what should I say about how we know? Keeping it to a paragraph.
watched some chicks flatten themselves when a hawk shadow went over. what's the name for behaviour like that?
My kid's space book skips this bit. What did gravity pull together first after the Big Bang?
explaining food chains to my year 4 group next week. where do herbivores get most of their energy, and how would you put that to nine year olds without it turning into a lecture?
I bank 20% of my $100000 salary and want 20 retired years at 40% of it. Years left to work?
making a chart of my class's favourite colours. of the 40 kids half said blue, a quarter of the rest said green, and the others said yellow. how many for yellow? want to check before i draw it.
Reading up on fuelling before long rides. What sets off glycogen breakdown in working muscle?
helping at my mum's office with the post. 60 letters needed stamps, i did a third of them and added those to the stamped pile, which now has 30. how many were in it before i started?
Been eating more than I move since the weather turned. What does the body do with food it takes in but doesn't use?
we breed rabbits and i'm trying to sort out which parent gives what. which cell passes the mother's traits to the offspring, and how far does her side carry into a litter?
My son is building a model suspension bridge and asked why the real ones use steel cable. Which property of steel suits that job, and what's it holding out against?
party's saturday. i've got 2 cases of 24, 70 guests coming, 2 bottles each. how many more?
Trying to work out my aircon. It cools 2 degrees an hour on low, 3 on high, and the room gains 2 an hour switched off. I ran low 3 hours, high 4, then off 2. How much cooler than the start?
my daughter is drawing the Earth for a school display and wants to label the gas layers round it. what's the whole thing called, and what are the layers in order?
Watching the geese head off again. Which two environmental changes get animals migrating?
Ran an nmr on a dmso and acetonitrile mix, lines alpha and 3alpha, [DMSO]:[AN]?
we had drosophila silvarentis under the light microscope today and the polytene chromosomes were obvious, what are they?
We're growing tomatoes on the balcony and the fertiliser box goes on about energy stores. what form do plants actually store energy in, and how does it get into that form? plain words please.
our roll is 3000, half over 16 a quarter of them male, half under 16 half male. how many girls?
coach has me down for 8 laps tomorrow, 0.25 km a lap, and I'm meant to take 60 ml of water per kilometre. how many millilitres should I bring? want to fill the bottle right.

Packing a crate that weighs 20 pounds with one pink frog, blue beetle, green toad, yellow snake and red bird. the frog matches the beetle and toad at 50 pounds, sits 10 under the snake and 20 over the bird. total?
On placement this week a nurse told me never to use plain water for a bladder washout in secondary care but wouldn't say why. what's the actual risk?
my nine year old asked why the planet keeps warming and I fumbled it. can you explain how the greenhouse effect works, from sunlight coming in to heat getting stuck, so I can repeat it?
The mill by us replanted the block they logged last year, what would you call that?
my kid has to pick the parasitic one out of a woodpecker nesting in a dead tree, a tapeworm absorbing food in a wolf's gut, a polar bear hunting a seal, and a hummingbird carrying pollen.
the spin instructor keeps saying we've gone anaerobic near the end. does anaerobic metabolism mean atp made without any oxygen used, or atp made when there's no oxygen available?
Running a plant setup at home, 20 tomato plants, same water each, different sunlight, counting the fruits every day. which bit of that is the dependent variable?
A mate is pushing a savings scheme where $300 earns simple interest of three quarters of the original amount every year. what's the total after 3 years, and can you show the maths?
the shop did 20 helium balloons for $900 last week and has since put the price up by $20 a balloon. I need 170 for a hall booking on saturday, so what am I in for?
We've a pond full of fish all of the same species and some clearly do better year after year. what actually lets some of them survive at a higher rate than the rest of their own kind?
going through a receipt: twice as many red ties as blue, red 50% dearer each, blue totalling $200 at $40 each. what did I spend on ties?
quick one for my ward notes, where in the brainstem are the vital centres?
My brother hiked 14 km/h for 8 hours, I managed 9 for 5. how far ahead is he?
the soil out back has packed down hard and barely holds any water now. which animals would actually help it hold water again?
uncle set this at dinner and I can't crack it. ruby is 6 times sam's age now and in 9 years she'll be 3 times his age, so how old is sam, and how do you set the thing up so I can follow it?
Shopping for a telescope and the specs list resolution, what does that measure?
budget check on $6000 a month: a quarter on rent, a third on fuel, half of the rest donated, $200 to my daughter and $700 to my wife. what's left?
our maple turns red every autumn, what's that an example of the tree doing?
Sorting the fridge and my flatmate and I ended up disagreeing over which of yogurt, cream, soap or cooking oil is made using bacteria. which is it, and what do the bacteria do?
at the cookout I had 2 hot dogs, tom had three times more, john had half of tom's. difference?
we're messing about with a cart and a pulley in the garage and want to predict the next run. if the force goes up four times, how much does the acceleration increase? newton's second law, I think.
the litter's 27, two thirds pomeranian, a third of those girls. how many girls?
Baking greek orange pies with my sister, she brought five boxes of ten oranges and I brought 20 more than her. three oranges a pie, so how many can we make?
poking at a circuit on the bench, current of 3 and a total resistance of 12. what voltage does that give me, which formula gets me there, and how do the units land?
reading a philosophy book that keeps pointing at a view placing morality outside reason, in an emotional moral impulse towards others. which one is that?
Setting up a run on our 600 mhz machine where the 13c starts at p = 1 with t1 of 5.0 s. how long until p reaches twice the thermal equilibrium polarisation at 298 k? working too if you can.
we've got miconia spreading over our land in hawaii, shallow roots crowding out the deep-rooted natives and the slope slipping. what's the best way to deal with it?
Counting a jar of 4500 jelly beans, red 1% under blue and green 1% over blue. how many more green than red?
put a tray of juice in the freezer last night, what's it done by now?
reading up on flowering plants while I plan a bed. what does an angiosperm have that no other plant group does? alternation of generations shows up elsewhere so it can't be that.
Watching a documentary about glaciers, the slow sheets of ice on land. when that ice gets heated to 5 degrees celsius, what's the process called?
writing a bit of science fiction set on europa, out at jupiter's 5 au. how many times brighter would the sun have to be for europa to get the same solar flux as earth, 1380 w/m2?
fencing a 15 by 10 foot garden at 2 slats a foot, how many do I buy?
Helping my nephew with science and he asked what the electromagnetic spectrum is. what is it a range of, exactly?
walked a quarry at the weekend and picked up a slab with what looks like a fern pressed into it. which type of rock would a fern imprint most likely be in, and why that one?
my daughter has to sort baking a cake, frying an egg, burning toast and squeezing juice from fruit and pick the one that's only a physical change. which is it, and how do I explain it?
got an aneroid sphygmomanometer at home, what's the smallest increment?
Reading about proton therapy: work to take mass m from rest to 0.6c?
boxing 200 crayons 8 to a box, boxes 8 ounces, crayons 1 ounce each. total in pounds, 16 ounces to the pound?
For a story: mars is nearly all co2, so why so little greenhouse warming?
Sorting out the week: dance is 1 hour tuesday, 2 hours thursday, and the saturday session runs twice as long as the tuesday one. how many hours a week does that come to altogether?
running numbers for the shop, we make 10 dozen doughnuts a day at $2 each. if they all go every day, what do we take across june? want the working so I can redo it for other months.
My son took an old telephone apart and asked how it carries sound. what happens to the sound inside it?
dad's catheter won't unblock and it won't come out. what do I do now?
sorting chem flashcards: which bonds alike, cl br f, k ca sc, kr cl o, be c o?
Joined an asteroid hunting group, what makes them stand out in surveys?
my nephew got handed this one and I can't crack it. a farm has only sheep and geese, 70 legs, 20 heads, how many sheep?
picked up a cheap telescope last month and saturn's finally clearing my balcony rail. people keep mentioning the cassini division of the rings. what is it exactly, and will I be able to see it?

My daughter is twelve and asked me why electrons stay where they do around the nucleus, and I gave her a terrible answer. What two things actually decide where an electron ends up? Something I can repeat back.
I'm on phones 6 hrs a day, 15 min a call, 5 days. How many calls is that?
cutting sugar this month. which molecules break down into fructose in the body?
Watching a doc on Edison tonight. How'd he most likely invent the light bulb?
putting together flashcards for a bio unit on the kingdoms and got stuck on one. eubacteria, archaebacteria and protista, what cellular structure do all three share? a short reason would help
a friend and I disagree on viruses. what makes something an organism?
Helping catalogue books for a swap. Sofie, Anne and Fawn brought 85 between them. Sofie has 25 more than Anne, and Anne has 12 fewer than Fawn, and I need Fawn's count for the sheet. How many?

we're doing a silly display at the bakery, everything we bake in a day lined up end to end. that's 300 rolls at 4 inches, 120 chocolate croissants at 6 inches, and 60 baguettes at two feet. how many feet?
Sorting a carrot delivery. 200 lbs, 40 restaurants, 2 lbs each. Leftovers?
homework. a uniform solid disk rolls from rest down a ramp, no slipping. what fraction of its KE is rotational?

basement's damp so I got a dehumidifier. low takes out 1 liter a day, medium is double that, high is double medium. ran it 3 days low, 3 days medium, 5 days high. how much water did it pull altogether?
Tracking my kids' bike rides. Chase and Rider go three times a day for five days, then twice that on the other two days. What's the weekly total?
kid asked me at bedtime why the moon circles the earth and I blanked

we pulled the carpet out of the hallway and put down tile, and now that stretch feels freezing to walk on barefoot even though the heating hasn't changed. why does tile feel so much colder than carpet?
Student council wants data on where's quietest to study in our school. How?
reading a pop astronomy book that keeps talking about actual brightness versus how bright something looks from here. if those are the only two things known about an object, what can you figure out?
Our tortoise goes still for weeks every winter and the vet called it dormancy rather than hibernation. How are those two similar in animals, and what happens in the body in each case?
Shop lists 2 sandwiches for $3, 4 for $6, 8 unpriced. Same rate, so how much?
me and a mate flip in turns, first head wins. odds for whoever goes first?

I do estimating for a small building firm and the lumber rep mentioned some logging companies don't replant after they cut. Mills are already far from the forest. How would that hit people like us later?
got bloodwork back with a note about lymph nodes and now I'm trying to understand the system they belong to. which organs are part of the lymphatic system, and roughly what does each of them do?
dad turned 45 this week and joked that he's 5 years short of double my age. so how old does that make me? I can never do these in my head
Saw a demo with a metal rod over a burner and a thermometer on the far end. What's going on that makes the reading climb?
my oven runs hot. set it to 450 and a probe reads 468, and it seems to be off by the same percentage across the range. tonight's recipe wants 520. what number should I actually dial in?
Filling in a form for my niece and got confused. She'll be 16 in 12 years, so how old is she 4 years from now?
growing basil in three different water mixes at home and measuring the roots every other day for eight weeks. what unit should I record the growth in so the numbers stay useful?
Writing up a section on corporate transparency for work and a colleague pointed me at Schnackenberg and Tomlinson from 2014. What are the three criteria they give for assessing transparency quality?
kids asked at dinner, if the moon had earth's mass and size, what changes here?

Quadrupling my brownie recipe for a bake sale. It normally needs 3 cups flour and 1 cup milk, and the shop sells flour in 2-cup bags and milk in 2-cup bottles. How many more bags of flour than bottles?
planning runs around the heat. when is the day usually hottest?
revising for placement. palpable left parasternal impulse means what?
